notes: v012 is selected and v013 underdetermined, both resolving to the base; the English matches.
The verse-opening And is added: the ASV recasts the relative clause as an independent sentence, ὅ is spent on this and καί on also, so no token licenses the connective (rules 5, 86).
Heading ἀναιρουμένων on death follows rule 17's support-frame clause; heading it on put remains defensible since ἀναιρέω carries its own verbal sense.
against at t037 realizes the preverb κατα- of κατήνεγκα (rule 106), and them is a resumptive pronoun folded under rule 7, αὐτῶν being already spent on they (rule 103).
